final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS mean_anlycount FROM pair_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - m.mean_anlycount AS margin FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_anlycount > m.mean_anlycount), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_margin, avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_mean_across_trader_types FROM per_type
